name: Max
canonical_description: A playful six-month-old German Shepherd puppy with black and tan fur, expressive brown eyes, a bright red collar, friendly facial expressions, and youthful puppy proportions. High-quality stylized 3D preschool animation with soft rounded features.
behavior_rules: Max communicates through movement, expressions, and gestures.
Max behaves like a young friendly puppy.
negative_rules: Never remove or change Max's red collar.
Never portray Max as an adult dog.
Never change Max's black and tan fur.
